units.source_text: 玉鬘思量如此安排，二女公子便可安住宫中了。

en.t: Tamakazura thought that with matters arranged in this way, her second daughter could live securely at court.

units.source_text: 然而想起那藏人少将，又觉得对他不起。

en.t: Yet when she thought of that Lesser Captain of the Chamberlains, she felt she had wronged him.

units.source_text: 他母亲云居雁曾经特地来信请求，玉鬘也曾在复信中暗示愿将二女公子许配。

en.t: His mother, Kumoi no Kari, had once written especially to ask for the match, and Tamakazura had hinted in her reply that she was willing to betroth her second daughter to him.

units.source_text: 如今忽然变卦，云居雁安得不见怪呢？

en.t: If she suddenly changed her mind now, how could Kumoi no Kari fail to take offense?

units.source_text: 为此不胜烦闷，便差次子右中弁去向夕雾右大臣说明，表示并无恶意。

en.t: Troubled beyond measure by this, she sent her second son, the Right Middle Controller, to explain to Yugiri, the Minister of the Right, that she meant no ill will.

units.source_text: 右中弁替母亲传言道：“今上有旨，欲令次女入宫。

en.t: Speaking on his mother's behalf, the Right Middle Controller said, "His Majesty has commanded that the second daughter enter court service.

units.source_text: 世人看见我家一人入院，一人入宫，将以我为好名。

en.t: When people see one daughter of our house entering the Retired Emperor's service and another entering the palace, they will think I am greedy for honor.

units.source_text: 真教我难于应付了。”

en.t: It has truly become very difficult for me to manage."

units.source_text: 夕雾右大臣答道：“听说今上为你家之事，心甚不快，这原是难怪的。

en.t: Yugiri, the Minister of the Right, replied, "I hear that His Majesty is deeply displeased about your family's affairs, and that is only natural.

units.source_text: 如今二女公子既为尚侍，若不入宫任职，又是失敬之事。

en.t: Now that the second young lady has been appointed Naishi no Kami, it would be disrespectful if she did not enter the palace to take up the post.

units.source_text: 还望早日决行为是。”

en.t: I hope you will decide to proceed without delay."

units.source_text: 此次玉鬘又向明石皇后探询，得其允可，然后送二女公子入宫任职。

en.t: This time Tamakazura also consulted Empress Akashi, and after receiving her approval, she sent her second daughter to the palace to serve.

units.source_text: 她想：“如果我夫在世，她不致屈居人下。”

en.t: She thought, "If my husband were still alive, she would not have had to take a place beneath another."

units.source_text: 思之不胜凄凉之感。

en.t: Thinking this, she was overcome with desolate sorrow.

units.source_text: 今上久闻大女公子以美貌著名，如今求之不得，只获得一个尚侍，心有不足之感。

en.t: His Majesty had long heard that the eldest daughter was famous for her beauty, and now, unable to obtain her and receiving only a Naishi no Kami instead, he felt unsatisfied.

units.source_text: 然而这二女公子亦甚贤惠，仪态优雅，颇能胜任尚侍之职。

en.t: Even so, this second young lady was also very virtuous and kind, with graceful manners, and she was well able to fulfill the duties of Naishi no Kami.

units.source_text: 前尚侍玉鬘心事既了，便想出家为尼。

en.t: Once her worries were settled, Tamakazura, the former Naishi no Kami, wished to leave the world and become a nun.

units.source_text: 诸公子都来谏阻：“目下两妹尚须照顾，母亲即使出家，亦不能安心修持。

en.t: All her sons came to dissuade her, saying, "At present our two younger sisters still need your care, and even if you take vows, Mother, you will not be able to practice in peace.

units.source_text: 且待两人地位安稳，无须顾虑之时，母亲方可专心学道。”

en.t: Please wait until both of them are securely settled and there is nothing left to worry about; only then will you be able to devote yourself fully to the Way."

units.source_text: 玉鬘夫人便暂时打消出家之念。

en.t: Lady Tamakazura therefore put aside, for the time being, her wish to become a nun.

units.source_text: 此后常常微行入宫。

en.t: After that, she often went quietly and privately to the palace.
